papers.title: Quantum assisted Gaussian process regression
papers.abstract: Gaussian processes (GP) are a widely used model for regression problems in supervised machine learning. Implementation of GP regression typically requires $O(n^3)$ logic gates. We show that the quantum linear systems algorithm [Harrow et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 103, 150502 (2009)] can be applied to Gaussian process regression (GPR), leading to an exponential reduction in computation time in some instances. We show that even in some cases not ideally suited to the quantum linear systems algorithm, a polynomial increase in efficiency still occurs.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文探讨量子计算加速高斯过程回归，未涉及有限元代理建模或生物力学设计。
llm.why_not_core: No FEA validation, no surrogate modeling for physical systems, no uncertainty quantification emphasis, and no biomechanical or implant design context.

summary_zh.method: 应用量子线性系统算法于高斯过程回归
summary_zh.result: 在特定情况下实现指数级加速

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the cubic computational cost of Gaussian process regression using quantum linear systems algorithms.
summary_en.method: The quantum linear systems algorithm is applied to solve the matrix inversion in Gaussian process regression.
summary_en.result: Exponential speedup is achievable in certain cases, with polynomial improvement in less ideal scenarios.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical proof of computational complexity reduction.

papers.title: Stable Fixation of a Cementless, Proximally Coated, Double Wedged, Double Tapered Femoral Stem in Total Hip Arthroplasty: A 5-Year Radiostereometric Analysis
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, Harris Orthopaedic Laboratory, Massachusetts General Hospital, Boston, Massachusetts

corresponding_authors.name: Audrey K. Nebergall
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, Harris Orthopaedic Laboratory, Massachusetts General Hospital, Boston, Massachusetts

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为临床5年RSA随访，未涉及有限元或应力分析，但对用户的研究方向仅提供背景参考。
llm.why_not_core: This paper provides clinical migration data but does not include any finite element modeling, stress shielding quantification, or micromotion contact mechanics analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估一种特定设计的无骨水泥股骨柄的5年稳定性。
summary_zh.method: 采用放射立体测量分析（RSA）对55例患者进行5年随访。
summary_zh.result: 该股骨柄在5年内表现出微小迁移和稳定固定。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the 5-year stability of a specific cementless femoral stem design using radiostereometric analysis.
summary_en.method: Fifty-five patients were followed for 5 years with RSA to measure stem migration.
summary_en.result: The stem demonstrated minimal migration and stable fixation over the 5-year period.
